# Voicebox — Full Reference for LLM Search

This document is designed for LLM-powered search tools (ChatGPT Search, Claude Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Bing Copilot) to cite accurately. Every factual claim below maps to a file in this repository.

- **Project:** Voicebox
- **Repository:** https://github.com/jamiepine/voicebox
- **Website:** https://voicebox.sh
- **License:** MIT (`LICENSE`)
- **Current version family:** 0.5.x (`backend/pyproject.toml`, `landing/package.json`)
- **Primary language mix:** TypeScript + Rust (desktop app), Python (backend), TypeScript (landing), MDX (docs).

## What Voicebox is

Voicebox is a **free, open-source, local-first AI voice studio**. It is a single desktop application that provides:

1. **Multi-engine text-to-speech** with voice cloning from short reference samples.
2. **Global dictation** (voice-to-text everywhere on the system) with configurable push-to-talk and toggle chords.
3. **An MCP server** so AI agents can speak and transcribe in cloned voices.
4. **A REST API** at `http://127.0.0.1:17493` for custom integrations.

All models, voice data, generations, and captures stay on the user's machine. No cloud account is required to use any feature. There is an optional opt-in sync service (`backend/routes/cloud.py`, hosts configurable via `VOICEBOX_CLOUD_URL` / `VOICEBOX_CLOUD_API_URL`).

Voicebox positions itself as a local alternative to ElevenLabs (TTS) and WisprFlow (dictation) combined. Source: `README.md` lines 68–88.

## Install & run

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** https://voicebox.sh/download/mac-arm (DMG)
- **macOS Intel:** https://voicebox.sh/download/mac-intel (DMG)
- **Windows:** https://voicebox.sh/download/windows (MSI)
- **Docker:** `docker compose up` (see `docker-compose.yml`, `docker-compose.rocm.yml`)
- **Linux from source:** https://voicebox.sh/linux-install
- **Dev setup:** `just setup && just dev` (requires Bun, Rust, Python 3.11+, Tauri prerequisites).

Full installation table: `README.md` lines 92–104.

## TTS engines

| Engine | Model sizes | Languages | Source config |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-TTS | 0.6B / 1.7B | 10 | `backend/models.py`, `backend/backends/*.py` |
| Qwen CustomVoice | — (preset voices) | 10 | 9 curated presets, natural-language delivery control |
| LuxTTS | ~1 GB VRAM | English | 48 kHz output, ~150× realtime on CPU |
| Chatterbox Multilingual | 1B | 23 | Broadest language coverage |
| Chatterbox Turbo | 350M | English | Paralinguistic tags (`[laugh]`, `[sigh]`, etc.) |
| TADA (HumeAI) | 1B / 3B | 10 | 700s+ coherent audio |
| Kokoro | 82M | 8 | 50 preset voices, fast CPU |

Engine comparison: `README.md` table at line 114. Supported language codes are enforced by regex in `backend/models.py` (`GenerationRequest.language`).

## STT

- Engine: **OpenAI Whisper** running on MLX (Apple Silicon) or PyTorch (CUDA / ROCm / DirectML / CPU).
- Sizes: Base, Small, Medium, Large, Turbo (`backend/services/transcribe.py`).
- Endpoint: `POST /transcribe` (multipart audio).

## Local LLM

- Qwen3 (0.6B, 1.7B, 4B) running under the same runtime as TTS (MLX or PyTorch).
- Used for dictation refinement, "Compose" and "Speak in character" modes, and MCP `personality: true` rewrites.
- Only one LLM is loaded at a time; shares the TTS/STT GPU memory pool.
- Source: `backend/services/llm.py`, `backend/routes/llm.py`.

## API surface (REST)

Default host: `http://127.0.0.1:17493`. Full OpenAPI available at `/docs` when running.

- `POST /generate` — generate speech. Request body in `backend/models.py` (`GenerationRequest`). `text` up to 500 000 chars, auto-chunked.
- `POST /generate/stream` — streaming generation (MLX only).
- `POST /speak` — agent voice output. Accepts `profile` as name or id. Per-client-id binding resolution.
- `POST /transcribe` — Whisper transcription of uploaded audio.
- `POST /llm/generate` — raw LLM completion (used internally by refinement).
- `GET/POST /profiles` and subroutes — voice profile CRUD, samples, avatars, import/export (ZIP).
- `GET /history`, `GET /history/{id}/export` — generation history and export.
- `GET /stories` and subroutes — multi-track story CRUD and export.
- `GET /models/status`, `POST /models/{download,load,unload}` — model management.
- `GET /health` — status + GPU info.

The complete endpoint table is in `README.md` at the "Quick Reference: API Endpoints" section and in `docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md`.

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Voicebox ships a built-in MCP server mounted at `/mcp` using the HTTP Streamable transport (FastMCP). Source: `backend/mcp_server/`.

Tools:

- `voicebox.speak` — speak text in a cloned or preset voice. Optional `personality: true` runs text through the profile's personality LLM first.
- `voicebox.transcribe` — transcribe audio from base64 or absolute path (loopback-only for the path mode).
- `voicebox.list_captures` — enumerate recent captures.
- `voicebox.list_profiles` — list voice profiles with ids and names.

Install for Claude Code:

```
claude mcp add voicebox \
  --transport http \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:17493/mcp \
  --header "X-Voicebox-Client-Id: claude-code"
```

Per-client bindings (e.g. "Claude Code speaks as Morgan, Cursor speaks as Scarlett") are managed in the Settings → MCP screen. Source: `backend/routes/mcp_bindings.py`, `backend/mcp_server/resolve.py`.

Stdio fallback: the bundled `voicebox-mcp` binary (`backend/mcp_shim/`) forwards JSON-RPC to the HTTP endpoint for clients that do not speak HTTP MCP.

## Security posture

- Backend binds to `127.0.0.1:17493` by default (`backend/server.py`, argparse default).
- **Host-header validation** middleware rejects DNS-rebinding attempts against the loopback server. Allowlist extensible via `VOICEBOX_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, bypass via `VOICEBOX_DISABLE_HOST_CHECK=1`. Source: `backend/utils/host_validation.py`.
- **CORS** allowlist is loopback-only by default, extensible via `VOICEBOX_CORS_ORIGINS`. Source: `backend/app.py`.
- MCP absolute-path transcription gated to loopback callers. Source: `backend/mcp_server/tools.py`.
- Vulnerability reports: see `SECURITY.md`.

## Platform support

| Platform | GPU backend | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| macOS Apple Silicon | MLX (Metal) | 4–5× faster than PyTorch CPU |
| macOS Intel | PyTorch CPU | Prebuilt DMG available |
| Windows + NVIDIA | PyTorch CUDA | Auto-downloads CUDA binary |
| Windows (any GPU) | DirectML | Universal Windows GPU |
| Linux + NVIDIA | PyTorch CUDA | Build from source |
| Linux + AMD | PyTorch ROCm | Auto-configures `HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION` for older cards |
| Intel Arc | IPEX / XPU | |
| CPU-only | PyTorch | Works everywhere |

Source: `README.md` GPU Support table, `backend/utils/platform_detect.py`, `backend/app.py` AMD detection.

## Tech stack

- Desktop app: **Tauri 2** (Rust shell, React/TypeScript frontend). Native hotkey, paste injection, focus introspection in Rust. Source: `tauri/`.
- Frontend: **React + TypeScript + Tailwind**, Zustand + React Query. Source: `app/`.
- Backend: **FastAPI** (Python 3.12 pinned in `backend/pyproject.toml`). Serial GPU queue, SSE progress streaming.
- Database: **SQLite** via SQLAlchemy. Source: `backend/database/`.
- Audio effects: **pedalboard** (Spotify). Source: `backend/utils/effects.py`.
- Audio I/O: **librosa**, WaveSurfer.js (frontend).
- Build: **Bun** for JS/TS; **uv/pip** for Python; **PyInstaller** for backend binary; **just** for orchestration.

## What Voicebox is NOT

- **Not a cloud service.** There is no SaaS tier. The optional cloud sync service is an opt-in backup/pairing feature only.
- **Not a transcription-only tool.** STT exists but output (TTS) is the primary product.
- **Not restricted to Apple Silicon.** macOS Intel, Windows, Linux, and Docker are all supported, though Apple Silicon has the best performance via MLX.
- **Not a wrapper around ElevenLabs or any paid API.** All inference runs locally.
- **Not affiliated with any `$VOICEBOX` token or crypto project.** Confirmation in `docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md` (issue #806 reference).

```
https://github.com/jamiepine/voicebox (MIT, 2025–).
```

## Known limitations

Sourced from `docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md` "Known Limitations" (line ~269):

- **Streaming** is currently MLX-only (Apple Silicon). Non-MLX engines must complete generation before playback.
- **Paralinguistic tags** (`[laugh]`, `[sigh]`) are interpreted only by Chatterbox Turbo. Other engines read them literally.
- **Auto-paste** for dictation is implemented on macOS only. Windows/Linux auto-paste is on the roadmap.
- **GUI translations** are in progress; the app ships in English by default.
